answer: Before a first payout, each account must receive a one-time paper letter at a real postal address with a printed code that the owner enters with a signature from the account key. Two clerks match it against the mailing record within fourteen days; a wrong code or second account at the same address is refused and the address barred. One honest user waits for a single letter to cross the bridge to his home. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 distinct deliverable addresses, from ridge farms to lagoon villages, since reusing one address burns both accounts.
